title: Normative Modules: A Generative Agent Architecture for Learning Norms that Supports Multi-Agent Cooperation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development of 'normative competence' in generative agents, specifically evaluating their ability to recognize, reason about, and adapt to social norms and authoritative institutions. This includes benchmarking how agents handle punishment, sanctioning, and acceptable group behaviors, which are fundamental components of normative and ethical reasoning in multi-agent systems.
